## Open (10)

| Key | Value | Source | Rationale |
|---|---|---|---|
| `cohort.missing_baseline_pain` | `not_sx` (choices: not_sx, exclude) | Lo 2018 Results list no exclusion for a blank baseline frequent-pain answer (26 people) | not_sx keeps them, counted as without frequent symptoms at baseline |
| `mahmoudian.jsn_rule` | `incident` (choices: incident, any_increase) | Mahmoudian 2023: 'incidence of radiographic joint space narrowing (yes/no)' in either tibiofemoral compartment | incident: JSN grade 0 at baseline and >= 1 at V06 (a within-grade 0.5 is not incident); any_increase: the grade rises |
| `mahmoudian.knee_pick` | `random` (choices: random, right, left) | Mahmoudian 2023 OARSI abstract: one knee per subject randomly included if both were eligible | Their random draw cannot be reproduced; the seed fixes ours |
| `mahmoudian.missing_followup_pain` | `exclude` (choices: exclude, not_sx) | Mahmoudian 2023 does not say how a blank 4-year frequent-pain answer was handled for the 'remaining symptomatic' outcome | exclude: such a subject leaves that model only; not_sx: counted as not symptomatic |
| `mahmoudian.osteophyte_rule` | `sites` (choices: sites, grade_sum) | Mahmoudian 2023: 'increase (yes/no) in the number of osteophytes in either tibiofemoral compartment' | sites: more of the four OARSI sites (medial/lateral femur and tibia) graded >= 1; grade_sum: the sum of the four grades rises |
| `outcomes.arthroplasty_scope` | `right` (choices: right, either) | Lo 2018 Methods: 'Any participant with a knee arthroplasty was identified as having Sx, ROA, and SOA' | 'Any participant' could mean a replacement in either knee |
| `outcomes.replacement_counts` | `adjudicated_or_self_report` (choices: adjudicated_or_self_report) | oai.derive.knee.REPLACEMENT_STATUS_COUNTS (from Lo 2022 p.1661): V99E*RPCF of 1 (self-reported) or 3 (adjudicated, confirmed), or RPSN = 1 (seen on a follow-up X-ray). Lo 2018 says only 'any participant with a knee arthroplasty' | A counted replacement with no day count (V99E*DAYS blank) never becomes SOA at a follow-up visit |
| `outcomes.roa_rule` | `same_visit` (choices: same_visit, ever) | Lo 2018 Methods: ROA = tibiofemoral KL >= 2; whether ROA is carried forward once seen is not stated |  |
| `outcomes.soa_missing` | `both_required` (choices: both_required, known_false) | Lo 2018 does not say whether SOA is missing or known absent when one component (pain or KL) is missing | known_false: no frequent pain (or KL < 2) rules SOA out even if the other component is missing |
| `periods.after_missing_outcome` | `continue` (choices: continue, stop) | Lo 2018 Results: 750 of 11,994 potential observations missing the outcome were excluded; follow-up after them is not described |  |

## Variants

| Variant | Sets | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `exclude_missing_pain` | `cohort.missing_baseline_pain = exclude` | Blank baseline frequent pain excludes the person (as in Lo 2018) |
| `mahmoudian_any_jsn_increase` | `mahmoudian.jsn_rule = any_increase` | Mahmoudian anchor: any rise in JSN grade counts |
| `mahmoudian_left` | `mahmoudian.knee_pick = left` | Mahmoudian anchor: the left knee when both are eligible |
| `mahmoudian_osteophyte_grade_sum` | `mahmoudian.osteophyte_rule = grade_sum` | Mahmoudian anchor: a rise in the summed osteophyte grades counts |
| `mahmoudian_right` | `mahmoudian.knee_pick = right` | Mahmoudian anchor: the right knee when both are eligible |
| `require_s2` | `exposure.require_s2 = true` | Periods and four-year rows need both the exam item and S2 (head-to-head on the same rows) |
